title: El imperio español
goal: Read how Spain actually governed an empire an ocean away: viceroyalties that kept splitting, a trade monopoly run from one city, and a legal loophole for ignoring royal orders.

items: Name the first two viceroyalties and when they were created.
Explain why two more viceroyalties were created centuries later.
Describe what the Casa de Contratación controlled.
Explain how 'se obedece pero no se cumple' actually worked.
Use passive voice (ser vs. estar + participle) to describe colonial institutions.
